answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each trading identity to post a bonded stake whose reputation propagates along a vine of attested counterparties rather than self-asserted keys. Colluders who spin up fake identities to fake volume must post collateral that scales with the delta between claimed and observed settlement flow, with each new lotus identity. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
